log.text: First pass. Craigslist: 48 results with house/dogs/W-D filters; 10 kept after removing likely scams ($780–$1,350 'houses'), rooms for rent, duplicate posts, and listings outside Portland (Gresham, Beaverton, Clackamas, Vancouver, Cedar Mill, Amity). Zillow: 109 results; first 41 added (yard and dishwasher not yet checked; Zillow blocks automated reads of listing pages).
Added each listing's main photo (from the listing itself). All 10 Craigslist posts were still live.
Added availability dates: 35 of 47 listings state one (Zillow search results; Craigslist post details). The rest don't say.

Added Redfin: 41 new Portland houses (dogs allowed + in-unit W/D per Redfin; 19 outside city limits or units left out). Walk/Transit/Bike Scores (via Redfin) on 62 listings; 26 yard/dishwasher/W-D unknowns on existing listings confirmed from Redfin.
